descriptions.text: Yesterday, DeFiLabs rugged $1.6M from its users on BSC via a backdoor function in their staking contract. Random projects rugging on BSC is nothing new. The shitcoin casino claims another set of victims.

DefiLabs on the BNB chain has run away, taking about $1.6 million. The privileged address 0xee08 drains user funds by exploiting the backdoor function withdrawFunds() in the vPoolv6 contract. DeFiLabs claimed on Twitter that the platform had “experienced unexpected issues” while it was “going through maintenance and updates.”
